summary: Master service recovery and complaint management with practical tools, ISO 10002-informed methods, and hands-on exercises. Enrol to improve resolution.
lede: Service recovery and complaint management gives customer-facing professionals a structured way to classify complaints, investigate service failures, and guide cases toward resolution. For service, contact centre, quality, and operations teams handling complaint volumes or escalations, the course covers intake and handoff controls, recovery responses, 5 Whys analysis, corrective action tracking, and complaint trend reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage complaint volumes, service failures, and escalation pressure in customer-facing operations. It suits people who already know the service environment and need a stronger method for recovery, governance, and reporting.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop, a spreadsheet tool, and if possible a sample complaint log or anonymized case records from your own work. You should be comfortable reading operational reports and using basic CRM or service desk terminology.
